title: Chorus product configuration
description: Product identity, versions, desktop update checks, and release settings, read by the apps and by scripts/release.

appId.description: Reverse-domain application ID: the macOS and Windows app ID, the iOS bundle identifier, and the Android package name. Changing it makes a different app in the stores.

name.description: Display name of the product, also used in window titles and file names of built packages.

applicationName.description: Lowercase machine name: the Linux executable and package name, the Expo slug, and the mobile deep link scheme.

versions.description: Versions of the two apps. A <version> tag (a bare version such as 1.2.3, without a v prefix) releases each app whose version equals the tag version.

desktop.description: Desktop app version; may be a prerelease such as 1.2.0-beta.1.

mobile.description: Mobile app version; must be a stable x.y.z version.

companyName.description: Author name written into the desktop packages.

companyEmail.description: Author email written into the desktop packages; Linux packages show it as the maintainer.

description.description: One-line product description written into the desktop packages.

homepage.description: Product homepage written into the desktop packages; Linux packages require it.

updates.description: How the desktop app checks for updates.

firstCheckSeconds.description: Seconds after start before the first update check.

laterHours.description: Hours before a version the user postponed with Later is offered again.

feeds.description: Update feeds, tried in order until one answers. {releasesRepository} is replaced with the releases repository in CI; a feed that still has a placeholder is left out of the build.

url.description: Address of the electron-updater generic feed that holds the update info files.

page.description: Release page opened when the app cannot install updates itself.

release.description: Settings of the Release workflow; the prepare job checks them before anything is built.

platforms.description: Which platforms a release builds. All five keys are required.

runners.description: GitHub Actions runner labels per system. The MAC_SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER repository variable overrides mac.

timeoutMinutes.description: Time limits of the release jobs, in minutes. build also limits how long the iOS signing keychain stays unlocked.

artifactRetentionDays.description: Days GitHub keeps the built packages as run artifacts.

retryAttempts.description: Attempts a run may reach through reruns of jobs that got no machine.

scripts.description: apps/desktop package script run on each system to build the installers for all its architectures.

checkStartupSeconds.description: Seconds a packaged app must keep running in the release check before it is asked to stop.

checkStopSeconds.description: Seconds a packaged app may take to quit after the release check asks it to stop.

androidArchitectures.description: Android ABIs compiled into the APK and AAB, such as arm64-v8a.

javaVersion.description: Java version installed for the Android build.

javaDistribution.description: Java distribution name accepted by actions/setup-java, such as temurin.

track.description: Google Play track the AAB is released to, such as production or internal.

status.description: Release status on that track: completed sends it for review, draft leaves it for manual release.

requestTimeoutMinutes.description: Time limit of each Google Play API request, in minutes.
